scheme_name: Award of Opportunity Cost to Parents of Scheduled Caste Girl Students
other_conditions: Girl student must be studying in Class VI to XII in a Government or Government recognized educational institution in Puducherry.
Girl student and her parent/guardian must be native of Puducherry by birth or continuous residence of at least 3 years.
Opportunity cost is payable only if the girl student has been promoted to the next higher class.
Opportunity cost is not payable for girls re‑admitted in a class for a second academic year due to failure or discontinuance.
benefits_summary: ₹3,000 per academic year is paid to the Scheduled Caste parent for each daughter studying in classes VI‑XII.
